banView.description: Hydrated view of a ban record as indexed by the AppView

indexedAt.description: When this ban was indexed by the AppView

actionRef.description: Stable reference to an action in a moderation service's log

serviceDid.description: DID of the service whose moderation log contains the action

actionId.description: Opaque service-local action identifier, not an AT-URI or CID

scopeView.description: Public scope in which a moderation decision applies

communityDid.description: DID of the scoped community; omitted on restricted-subject public projections

subjectRef.description: Reference to the repository record targeted by moderation

cid.description: CID of the observed record version, never the moderation action's version

communityDid.description: DID of the community the record was posted in, recorded when the action was taken

rootUri.description: AT-URI of the post at the root of a comment's thread, recorded when the action was taken; absent on actions recorded before 2026-10-13. The public log omits it when the root post has a doxing or illegal-content action or is no longer indexed

actorRef.description: Public reference to the actor responsible for a moderation action

did.description: DID of the actor responsible for the moderation action

actionView.description: Public projection of an entry in a moderation action log

ref.description: Stable reference to this moderation action

action.description: Moderation transition represented by this action

authorityDid.description: DID of the authority that issued the action

scope.description: Scope in which the action applies

createdAt.description: Time this moderation log recorded the action on its server

origin.description: Whether the action originated locally or was inherited from another authority

subject.description: Public subject targeted by the action

reason.description: Public reason classification for the action

labelValue.description: Content label applied or retracted by a label action

actor.description: Public actor responsible for the action

reverses.description: Earlier moderation action reversed by this action

issuedAt.description: Source label creation time, not a moderation-log sort key

contentSnapshot.description: Text of a removed subject, captured at removal; a restore carries the snapshot of the removal it reverses. Omitted when the subject is withheld or deleted by its author. In listAdminActions, a label or retract-label carries the post's current text, as on adminActionView. Returned by listActions and listAdminActions only, never in a mutation result

adminActionView.description: Administrative moderation action projection with private operator context

actorDid.description: Private DID of the administrator who performed the action

privateSubject.description: Private subject reference retained when the public projection restricts it or withholds its rootUri

privateNote.description: Private administrative note that is never included in public projections

contentSnapshot.description: Text of a removed subject, captured at removal, including when the public projection withholds it; a restore carries the snapshot of the removal it reverses. A label or retract-label carries the post's current text, omitted when the post is deleted, gone, or has a doxing or illegal-content action. Returned by listAdminActions only, never in a mutation result
Text of a record: as indexed when it was removed, or for a label or retract-label, as indexed now

linkUrl.description: URL of the post's external link embed

capturedCid.description: CID of the record version the snapshot was taken from

sourceView.description: Public authority source contributing to effective moderation state

authorityDid.description: DID of the authority that supplied this moderation source

scope.description: Scope in which this source applies

action.description: Moderation action that produced this source

reason.description: Public reason classification supplied by this source

label.description: atProto label supplied by this source

moderationView.description: Effective public removal and content-label state for a subject

state.description: Effective removal state; clear does not imply the subject is readable or unlabelled

sources.description: Public sources contributing to the effective removal state

sourcesTruncated.description: Whether additional removal sources were omitted from this projection

contentLabels.description: Effective public content labels on the subject

contentLabelView.description: Effective public content label and its contributing sources

sources.description: Public sources contributing to this content label

sourcesTruncated.description: Whether additional content-label sources were omitted from this projection

localLabelView.description: Locally applied content label and the action that established it

action.description: Local moderation action that established the label

subjectState.description: Versioned moderation and repository state for a subject

version.description: Opaque monotonic state token, not a CID

moderation.description: Effective public moderation state for the subject

recordState.description: Repository availability state of the subject record

currentSubject.description: Current strong reference when the subject record is present

localLabels.description: Content labels currently established by local actions

mutationResult.description: Result of an administrative moderation mutation

outcome.description: Whether the requested mutation changed moderation state

state.description: Authoritative subject state after the mutation

action.description: Administrative action created or reused by the mutation

reasonType.description: Extensible fully-qualified token reference for a public moderation reason

reasonSpam.description: Unsolicited, repetitive, or deceptive content classified as spam

reasonHarassment.description: Targeted abuse, intimidation, or repeated unwanted conduct classified as harassment

reasonDoxing.description: Publication or threatened publication of private identifying information

reasonIllegalContent.description: Content classified for public projection as violating applicable law

reasonRuleViolation.description: Violation of an applicable instance or community rule

reasonModeratorDiscretion.description: Moderation decision made under documented moderator discretion
